title: Relative weakly associated points under a finite morphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a morphism X -> S, a finite morphism i : Z -> X and a quasi-coherent F on Z, one has WeakAss_{X/S}(i_*F) = i(WeakAss_{Z/S}(F)) (source lines 1225-1232). The proof passes to fibres: the induced morphism i_s : Z_s -> X_s satisfies (i_*F)_s = i_{s,*}(F_s) by the affine base change formula, because a finite morphism is affine; the fibre-wise statement is then the absolute statement for finite morphisms, applied on each fibre.
